descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Play the drums like a rock hero and survive hell, fighting demons and epic bosses!

Features:

- Real Rock Experience: Hard rock, heavy metal, nu metal, and more. Play original tracks or hits from famous bands!

- DLC Hits: Jam along to songs from iconic groups like Linkin Park, Green Day, and The Offspring.

- Stylish & Intense Graphics: Crazy, detailed visuals and brutal finishing levels.

- TRUE Drum Set: Fully playable and customizable drum kit.

- Hours of Campaign: Over 4 hours of main story plus tons of extras.

- Dozens of Unlockables: Drumsticks, kits, songs, and more.

- Intuitive Gameplay: Easy to pick up, no dizziness, playable from your chair.

- Advanced Drumming: Perform flourishes, combos, and master complex rhythms.

- Phase-Based Enemies & Bosses: Special levels, unique worlds, and epic challenges.

- Online Rankings: Compete with friends and top the leaderboards.

- Musical Game Crossovers: Special versions of other videogame tracks!

- 4 Difficulty Levels: Suitable for beginners to pros, with balanced progression.
